chart.spaceMovesDownHint: Fast for calling out a run of depths

chart.scoreTapTooth: Go down to the next tooth

gettingStarted.tourFooter: A short tour of where everything lives in the chart.

welcome.title: Welcome to ToothOps
welcome.body: A 60-second tour of where everything lives. You can replay it any time from Settings → Getting started.

sections.title: The eight sections
sections.body: A dental record, top to bottom. Tap the chart’s title to jump between sections — everything autosaves.

patient.title: Patient & owner
patient.body: Name, owner contact, and the recheck date. Only the patient name is required to save.

species.title: Species & dentition
species.body: Pick Feline or Canine, then Permanent or Deciduous — the tooth layout follows.

grid.title: The charting grid
grid.body: Per-tooth measurements. Tap a cell and type, or tap a score — chart without looking up.

diagrams.title: Diagrams
diagrams.body: Tap a tooth to mark it; switch between Comment and Draw, add free notes. Undo and Redo are in the diagram’s toolbar.

codes.title: Code reference
codes.body: Search the full AVDC code set here, right with the diagram.

treatment.title: Treatment report & templates
treatment.body: Write the report, or insert a saved template — and save new ones to reuse.

patients.title: Patients
patients.body: Every patient’s visits. Saved visits open read-only until you tap Edit. Rechecks lists the patients due for a recheck.

dictate.title: Dictate
dictate.body: Tap Dictate and talk through your findings — from any page. Each one lands in the right place, and a live panel shows every change so you can undo anything.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Practice name & logo, team, recheck-reminder templates, your account — and this tour.

share.title: Share the PDF
share.body: Build the client-ready chart PDF with your logo, then share or save it whenever you’re ready.

whatsNew.severalTeeth: Tap tooth numbers in the grid to select several, then set one score on all of them.
whatsNew.customize: Every page has Customize in its More menu: hide columns, choose what shows beside the teeth, and more. Settings follow your account to every device.
whatsNew.leftOff: Opening ToothOps fresh shows Patients — unless today’s visit is still open — and today’s visit opens ready to edit.
